test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who does not tire easily
solution: The correct answer is: **Indefatigable** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Indefatigable **means never giving up or getting tired of doing something. (निरंतर काम करनेवाला; अथक या हार न माननेवाला; ऊर्जावान) • So, it is clear that '**Indefatigable**' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**One who does not tire easily**' Therefore, the correct answer is option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Pedantic **means too worried about rules or details. (नियमों और विवरणों पर अत्‍यधिक ध्यान रखने वाला; पंडिताऊ) • **Recluse **means a person who lives alone and who maintains very little contact with other people or society. (विरागी, संन्‍यासी) • **Libertine **means a person, who freely indulges in sensual pleasures without regard to moral principles. (एक व्यक्ति, जो नैतिक सिद्धांतों की परवाह किए बिना स्वतंत्र रूप से कामुक सुखों में लिप्त है) 3c:T90e, The erroneous part of the sentence is: **has gotten more direr**
